name: Ari
description: a young woman with a white chin-length bob with straight bangs whose tips fade to aqua, a plain teal headband, pale skin, large light blue eyes with long lashes, FULL SOFT LIPS, blue teardrop earrings, a gold chain necklace with one large round blue gem pendant in a gold setting resting at the front of her neck, an hourglass figure with a full bust, a narrow waist, wide hips and thick thighs. She wears a cropped glossy teal long-sleeved top with a black high collar and a black yoke across the shoulders, bare shoulders through the cut-outs, puffy teal sleeves with black ribbed cuffs; white high-waisted shorts with two vertical rows of three black buttons on the front; bare legs; chunky white platform sneakers with teal heart details and teal soles. No other accessories, no tattoos, no socks.
audit: lips: full and soft, as on the sheet's LIPS detail panel; never thin or flat
necklace: gold chain, the single large round blue gem in its gold setting hangs at the FRONT; from behind only the chain at the nape may show, never a pendant on the back; never missing
headband: plain teal band over the crown, no jewels, visible from every angle including the back of the head
earrings: one blue teardrop on each ear, visible on the side that faces the camera
hair: white with aqua only at the ends; the fade must not creep up; bangs straight; chin length
top: black high collar and black yoke continuous around neck and shoulders with bare shoulder cut-outs, glossy teal body, cropped above the shorts' waistband, black ribbed cuffs; no white on the top
shorts: white, high waist, 2x3 black buttons on the front; never teal, black or long; nothing on the legs
shoes: chunky white platform sneakers with teal heart details and teal soles, both feet in frame on body views
figure: hourglass - full bust, narrow waist, wide hips, thick thighs, pale skin; no tattoos, no bracelet, no anklet, no socks
frame: body views show head to soles with margin; face views head and shoulders; nothing cropped, no text, no sheet panels
background: a plain, even, pale mint background with no scenery or shadows
